method: Built-in imagegen generated neutral silver masters; Python tinting and layered assembly create all metal variants and awards.
crest:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated modular top crest accessory for a metallic hexagonal game rank badge, transparent PNG.
Input 1 (silver hexagonal badge) and input 2 (three-blade metallic wings) are MATERIAL AND GEOMETRY REFERENCES ONLY. Do not include either input object. Create ONLY ONE top crest, symmetric and compact, front-facing orthographic. Shape: a refined five-point angular crown-like crest, one tallest central spear-shaped point, two medium shoulder points and two short outer points, connected by a shallow beveled trapezoid base that will attach behind the top vertex of a hexagonal badge. Broad planar bevels, strong silhouette at small UI sizes, no tiny filigree. Roughly twice as wide as tall. Silver/charcoal grayscale metal matching the references, bright white specular edges, clean brushed facets. Entire object visible with padding on genuine alpha transparency. No badge, shield, wings, plate, text, numbers, stars, gemstones, circular balls, laurel, glow, or external shadow. A separate reusable accessory, not a complete insignia.
wings_extended:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated modular ADVANCED WING PAIR for the next progression tier of the supplied metallic badge, transparent PNG.
Input 1 is the badge MATERIAL REFERENCE. Input 2 is the existing short three-blade wing pair, DESIGN FAMILY REFERENCE. Generate a new more elaborate wing pair that visibly upgrades that same family: each wing has FIVE broad tapered stepped metal blades instead of three. Outer uppermost blade sweeps higher, progressively shorter blades below it form a graceful stepped fan. Slightly taller and fuller silhouette than the reference, angular engineered geometry, no realistic bird feathers, no airplane. Bilateral mirror symmetry, front-facing orthographic, neutral SILVER/charcoal only, polished bevels and white highlights matching the references. The small attachment roots are at the inner lower ends; outer tips point upward and outward. A very wide landscape composition, transparent center gap about 25% of total width, left and right wings separate with no crossbar. All tips visible with transparent margins. Actual transparent alpha outside and between blades. Do not include a badge, hexagon, plate, rank, crest, crown, text, emblem, stars, colored accents, glow, drop shadows, background or fake checkerboard. ONLY one coherent pair of advanced wings.
laurels:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: exclusive champion laurel wreath accessory for a metallic hexagonal achievement badge, transparent PNG.
Input 1 is a silver hexagonal badge MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY. Input 2 is its metallic wing accessory MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY. Create ONLY ONE paired laurel-branch ornament. Two elegant slender branches form a tall OPEN-TOP U-shaped wreath/cradle around a completely empty transparent center. Each branch has about ten clean angular lance-shaped leaves with broad metallic bevels, leaves pointing upward along the curved stem. The left and right stems meet or cross neatly at bottom center; tips end at upper left and upper right, leaving the entire upper center open for a separate crest. Exact bilateral symmetry, front-facing orthographic, no perspective. Overall ratio approximately 1:1, inner empty space is wide enough for a separate tall hexagonal badge; keep the branches narrow along the sides, not a dense bush. Polished neutral SILVER/charcoal grayscale only, crisp planar reflections and white highlights matching the references, refined tournament-winner ornament. Actual alpha transparency outside and throughout the empty center; all leaves and stems fully visible with padding. Do not include the badge, wings, shield, crown, plate, ribbon, text, numerals, stars, medallion, background, glow or cast shadow. This is one independent wreath accessory for later deterministic gold tinting.
